how: Specialist comics shops such as Album Comics on Boulevard Saint-Germain and Comics Records in the Marais sell new and back-issue comics for collectors.
Sport Decouverte runs 60 or 120 minute drone piloting introductions in Paris 16e covering safety rules and flying DJI Mavic drones supplied by the instructor.
A two-hour origami paper-art workshop for beginners (12+) is offered in Paris 11e, and private origami teachers give lessons in Paris 5e via Superprof.
A three-hour loom-weaving introduction in Paris 20e teaches warp setup and basic technique, and Paris Ateliers runs multi-day weaving stages on looms.
Cap Adrenaline runs a two-hour 'Basic time' watchmaking introduction in Paris 4e where participants partially dismantle and reassemble a mechanical movement, with longer 4.5-hour sessions available.
Paris Ateliers runs periodic multi-day flameworking (verre file) stages, and a two-hour torch glass-bead workshop is bookable in Paris 14e.
venue: Paris Ateliers / Funbooker atelier verre a la flamme

how: The Association Kitesurf Ile-de-France (AKIF) organises outings and trips for trained kitesurfers, and inland lakes such as Saint-Quentin-en-Yvelines are used by riders; coastal schools are far away.
venue: Base de loisirs de Saint-Quentin-en-Yvelines (AKIF outings)

how: The official Catacombes of Paris route and guided small-group visits give legal access to part of the underground quarries, while wider urban exploration is illegal.
Tree-canopy adventure courses with rope bridges and walkways operate near Paris, for example Ecopark Adventures in Creteil and Sherwood Parc in Viarmes.

Sport Decouverte hosts a 1h45 hands-on cheese-making workshop in Paris 10e where participants make a camembert-style or goat cheese to take home, and Paroles de Fromagers also lists cheese-making initiation.
Collector sneaker resale shops such as Larry Deadstock in the Marais and StockX Paris, plus periodic Sneakers Event Paris fairs and auctions, serve sneaker collectors.
Collectors buy and trade vintage watches through Paris dealers, Collector Square and Hotel Drouot auctions, though no regular club or bourse was found.
The Centre culturel de Chine a Paris has offered adult erhu (Chinese violin) classes, with an instrument lent in the first term; the source dates from 2015.
venue: Centre culturel de Chine a Paris

how: Club modeliste de Cachan (Val-de-Marne) has flown control-line (vol circulaire) model aircraft since 1948, builds models on Saturday afternoons and is a federation-labelled training school.
